composition: use a quiet copy panel for orientation text
show continuity through a few restrained memory motifs
text_policy: Narrative raster assets carry one exact short title plus one exact short subtitle; SVGs and tiny helper graphics stay text-free.
reject_when: the image turns private memory into a dense graph
the human/AI relationship is covered or ambiguous
the title or subtitle is unreadable
the mood becomes manipulative or romanticized
the asset implies product capabilities not supported by the docs
